title: Free LLM API Hub, free-model matrix (/api/v1/models.json)
description: One record per model key (the same groups as the model pages /models/<key>/), each with every provider that lists the model in its free-model sample (models_free). Every value is a recorded field of data/providers.json; null means not recorded and is never estimated. Model lists are a sample and change often: they are not part of the dataset's verified core claim. Contract v1: fields are only added within v1, so consumers must ignore fields they do not know; a field named here is never renamed, removed or retyped in v1. Added in dataset 2.16.0.

tristate.description: true or false as an official page states it; null means not confirmed (never false).

version.description: The dataset release version (SemVer), the same as in every other file of /api/v1/.

generated.description: The date of the last dataset change. The file depends only on the dataset, so it is byte-stable for a given dataset.

caveat.description: The sentence every model page carries: model lists are a sample and change often.

count.description: The number of models; equals the length of models.

pairs.description: The number of (model, provider) rows across all models.

key.description: The model key: the ID without deployment prefix, organisation prefix or OpenRouter's :free suffix, lower-cased, merged only with reviewed aliases. A different size, version or date is a different key.

name.description: The display name: the most frequent bare ID among the providers.

indexable.description: Whether the model page may be indexed by search engines (two or more verified providers list the model).

provider_count.description: The number of providers; equals the length of providers.

providers.description: One row per provider listing the model, in the explorer's recommended order (the order of the model page).

model_id.description: The exact ID the provider lists in models_free: the one to pass as model.

verified.description: Whether the provider entry is verified.

last_verified.description: The day the provider entry was last verified, or null for an unverified entry.

category.description: ongoing or trial, as in providers.json.

free_type.description: renewing-quota, perpetual, recurring-credit or trial-credit, as in providers.json.

expires.description: The expiry window as recorded (for example "30 days"), or null.

commercial_ok.description: Projected as in every v1 provider object: a conditional answer is null with commercial_ok_condition set.

commercial_ok_condition.description: The documented condition on commercial use, or null.

openai_base_url.description: The OpenAI-compatible base URL (HTTPS), or null when none is recorded.

data_policy.description: What the provider says about prompts, or null when nothing is recorded.

limits_scope.description: Which limits free_limits holds: model = numbers the provider publishes for this exact ID (free_limits.per_model in providers.json); provider = the provider-wide numbers, not specific to this model; none_published = the provider publishes no numeric free limits; not_recorded = nothing is recorded for this model.

free_limits.description: The numbers limits_scope names, with the page they come from and the day it was read; null for none_published and not_recorded. Numbers are never converted between units; an absent unit means no value is recorded for it.

scope.description: The models, plan or condition the provider ties the numbers to, in its own terms, or null.

provenance.description: Where the row can be checked.

source.description: The provider's model catalogue (models_url) when one is recorded, else its docs (docs_url); null when neither is an HTTPS URL.

checked.description: The day the provider entry was last verified; null for an unverified entry. The model sample itself is not part of the verified core claim.
